what: Controls for scripts/measure_originality.py -- the rule 2 copy search. Each exercises one outcome of the scanner against a tree built for the run.

controls.name: C3 near
controls.expects: 22 lines rewritten -> flagged as probable copy

controls.name: C3b near-only
controls.expects: the edited copy is NOT byte-identical, so EXACT must miss it

controls.name: C5 licence carve-out
controls.expects: MIT licence text appears in matches but keeps NO_COPY_FOUND

controls.name: C6 short-line floor
controls.expects: a file of only short lines cannot be flagged

controls.name: C7 self carve-out
controls.expects: copy inside this job's workspace: listed, verdict unchanged

controls.name: C8 self pair
controls.expects: the SAME copy, self pointed elsewhere -> REVIEW_REQUIRED
